source_name: Top 300 Most Asked LeetCode Questions (community curated)
selection_policy: Source advertises Top 300 but has 355 rows and 343 unique problems. Keep the first 300 unique problems in source topic order. Rank means source order, not a verified frequency ranking. Filter to public Medium questions plus explicitly constrained Easy practice variants. Verify every eligible entry against its official LeetCode page.
